bio: DoubleTree by Hilton London Ealing Hotel is a stylish hotel situated in the heart of West London. With modern amenities, comfortable accommodations, and exceptional service, this hotel offers guests a convenient and enjoyable afternoon.  Experience a delightful Afternoon Tea at W5 Bar & Kitchen within our hotel, where cosy and elegant setting creates the perfect ambiance. Relax in chic decor, comfortable seating, and natural lighting while indulging in a delicious selection of sandwiches, scones, cakes, and pastries with tea or a bit of fizz. The friendly staff ensures a memorable and enjoyable visit, making this charming setting an ideal choice. The menu typically features a choice of finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with clotted cream and jam, and an array of delicious cakes, pastries, and macarons. The sandwiches are made fresh and tailored to your taste buds, ensuring a delightful experience. Guests can also enjoy a variety of teas, coffees, and bubbly to accompany their food. Vegetarian or gluten-free options are also available to cater to different dietary needs.
